title: Joint Vision-Language Social Bias Removal for CLIP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval fairness using MaxSkew@k and NDKL@k metrics on demographically labeled datasets (FairFace, UTKFace, FACET), visualizing embedding clusters using t-SNE, and calculating effect sizes in embedding association tests (SEAT and IEAT) mapping gender attributes to neutral concepts (e.g., Career, Science).

Measuring unfair advantage in cross-modal retrieval tasks via mean MaxSkew@k and mean NDKL@k metrics on datasets with age annotations (FairFace, UTKFace), alongside embedding association tests (SEAT, IEAT) and t-SNE visual clustering.

Assessing retrieval fairness (MaxSkew@k, NDKL@k) on race-annotated datasets (FairFace, UTKFace) and calculating effect sizes of preferential associations using multi-modal embedding tests (SEAT, IEAT).

Probed in preliminary experiments using Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) and Image Embedding Association Test (IEAT) to quantify the preferential association of weight-related attributes with neutral concepts in image and text embeddings.
